detail: General Updates - ABFRL: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Limited has informed the Exchange about Pronouncement of Order by Hon ble National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench, regarding the Scheme of Amalgamation amongst Jaypore E-Commerce Private Limited, TG Apparel & Decor Private Limited and Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Limited and their respective Shareholders and Creditors.
